title: LocalizationLeftDerivedComparison
statement: For a localization L and a left-derived functor LF of F with counit alpha, an isomorphism beta from L followed by G to F determines LF isomorphic to G, with normalization L applied to the comparison followed by beta equal to alpha.

source.place: Final paragraph: rationalization and the common-stage coefficient construction; the following explicit conditional argument is agent-written.

proof.text: Fully faithful precomposition lifts alpha followed by beta inverse to LF to G. The left-derived universal property gives G to LF. The two composites are identities by the universal property and fully faithful precomposition. The lift equation gives normalization.
